title: 8,000 years of ceremonial-site artifacts documented by archaeologist Chris Roberts

tellings.quote: our archaeologist, Chris Roberts, has now documented going back over 8,000 years of artifacts

plain: An archaeologist named Chris Roberts has documented more than 8,000 years of artifacts from ceremonial sites at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, passes this on from Roberts' work, as a sign that people have treated the land as special for thousands of years.
